conviction_note: A mild positive. In Q3 (Jun-Aug) the yen was well weaker than the H2 rate implied by the July plan (USD about 157-160 against about 151, CNY about 23.5-23.8 against about 20.7). Demand proxies were strong (machine-tool orders +50%/+65% YoY in Jul/Aug, China excavators +19% in Aug). The IFIS consensus is stale and BELOW the company plan, so the Q3 profit headline should read as a beat. Against that: Nachi has not revised its forecast at Q3 in any of the last three years, so no guidance catalyst is expected; the margin long is crowded (信用倍率 15.9); and its last two strong prints spiked and then partly faded. Hence p_up 57 on a 4.5% scale gives +0.63, below the +1.0 findings sum, because the two measurements are kept apart.
bar: Q3 operating profit about 3.7bn yen. This is derived, not sourced: H2 plan OP 8,531m (FY 15,300m less H1 6,769m, https://www.nachi-fujikoshi.co.jp/dcms_media/other/20260714_2.pdf), split Q3/Q4 on FY2025's 43/57 seasonality. The only market number is the IFIS consensus: FY OP 12,350m / ordinary 10,850m, unchanged for four weeks and below the company plan (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6474, 2026-10-02). Its last Q3 consensus was OP 2,900m as of 2026-07-13, before the revision (https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/6474_20260714_act_20260714_150008_4). No current Q3 consensus could be sourced, so sizes are kept small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (no disclosed position >=0.5%, as of 20260929, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html); no change. 信用倍率 15.88 (kabutan page 2026-10-05, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6474), so leveraged retail is crowded long. Baseline priced_lean -0.886 (margin_overhang -0.6, runup -0.286). No option skew exists. Run-up +5.71% over 20 days and +3.8% over 5; Nikkei +2.3% on the morning of 10/05.

findings.finding: The July plan's FX assumption implies H2 at about USD 151 / EUR 176 / CNY 20.7 (FY plan 154/180/21.7 against H1 actual 157/184/22.7). Q3 traded at roughly USD 157-160, EUR 178-185, CNY 23.5-23.8. The company itself attributed +9億 of H1 OP to a similar-sized FX shift, which implies about +3-5億 of Q3 OP above the plan run-rate from FX alone.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At H1 (2026-07-14) a beat partly attributed to the weak yen plus a raised forecast took the stock from about 6,120 at the open to 6,490 the next close (+6.0%), after an intraday spike to 6,830.
findings.why_not_priced: FX is public, but the IFIS consensus (FY OP 12,350m, flat for 4 weeks) sits below even the company plan, so analysts have not marked the FX gap into numbers. Since the July spike the stock has fallen from 6,590 to 5,200 and is only now back at 5,740, which is not the path of a name priced for an FX upside.
findings.independence: FX series: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/JPY=X?range=6mo&interval=1mo. The H1 FX sensitivity (+9億) is from the company's 2026-07-22 presentation https://www.nachi-fujikoshi.co.jp/dcms_media/other/2611_20260724.pdf (same issuer, a different document).

findings.finding: Independent demand series for Nachi's end markets were strong in Q3: Japan machine-tool orders +50.4% YoY in July and +65.4% in August (the strongest since Oct 2021); China excavator sales +19.3% YoY in August (exports +32.7%); JARA robot orders +40% by value in Apr-Jun. The offsets are spot-welding robot shipments −18.9% and the company's own warnings of weak autos and car hydraulics, plus 'production cuts at some makers' in H2 construction machinery.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY2025 (2025-10-06): no revision, Q3 ordinary profit 4.8x YoY, '後場終盤に急伸'. On the corrected window, from the 3,860 open to the 3,930 next close, +1.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: These are industry proxies the market can see, so partly priced. Nachi's machine-tool unit was guided −10.7% for the year, so the tools business (which follows customers' machine utilisation) and hydraulics are the transmission. FA names have traded weakly since Yaskawa's July results (Fisco 2026-07-15), which suggests the sector rally has not reached this name.
findings.independence: China excavators: https://www.steelorbis.com/steel-news/latest-news/chinas-excavator-sales-increase-by-242-percent-in-january-august-2026-1475886.htm ; robot orders: https://www.jara.jp/data/dl/quarter/IR2026-04-06.pdf (different sources, different end markets).

findings.finding: The visible market bar is stale and low. IFIS consensus is FY OP 12,350m / ordinary 10,850m against the company's 15,300m / 13,300m, unchanged at 1 and 4 weeks, with a consensus target of 4,570 yen against a 5,760 price. A Q3 near the plan run-rate (OP about 3.8-4.2bn, roughly +60-70% YoY against 2,415m) will be screened as a beat against both consensus and the 5-year progress average.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At H1, the beat against a consensus 'slightly below the company plan' (Fisco) gave +6.0% on the window. At Q1 (2026-04-06), net profit fell 22% on a special loss and the window was −7.4%. Headline profit growth is what this name trades on in the last 30 minutes.
findings.why_not_priced: Coverage is thin: the consensus did not move after a 26% plan raise. Kabutan and IFIS surprise screens key off these numbers, so a large 'beat' label can still land at 15:00 even though the plan already implies it.
findings.independence: The Monex/IFIS 2026-07-13 consensus (Q3 OP 2,900m) is the same vendor: https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/6474_20260714_act_20260714_150008_4 . Not independent of the vendor, but independent of findings 1 and 2.

findings.finding: No forecast revision is likely at this print. Nachi held its full-year plan at Q3 in FY2023 (2023-10-04), FY2024 (2024-10-03) and FY2025 (2025-10-06), even when FY2025 was tracking well above plan, and it raised the plan and dividend only at H1 this year. So the release probably adds no guidance or return item, and the reaction rests on the quarter alone.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY2025 held the plan and the window still rose +1.8%. The H1 2026 raise spiked +11.6% intraday and was partly faded the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: Holders who bought the 7/14 raise and the October run-in may be hoping for a second raise as the yen stays weak. A hold would disappoint that minority. The effect is small because the hold is the company's habit.
findings.independence: kabutan revision history (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6474) shows the same pattern: revisions only at H1 (21/07, 23/07, 24/07, 26/07).

findings.finding: Leveraged retail is crowded long (信用倍率 15.88) and the last two strong prints followed a spike-then-fade path: 2026-01-14 +11.3% on the day then −5.5% the next, and 2026-07-14 +7.7% then −1.5% and −9% over three sessions ('出尽くし', Fisco 2026-07-15).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the corrected window both strong prints still closed positive (+5.8%, +6.0%) despite the fade, so the fade trims a positive rather than flipping it.
findings.why_not_priced: The margin overhang is already in the baseline lean (−0.6), so this is mostly priced. What is filed here is the next-day fade, which falls inside this window.

findings.finding: Nachi has been booking 構造改革 special losses alongside its results: one at Q3 FY2025 (2025-10-06), 8.1億 in H1 FY2026, and 1.64億 at Q1, where a 22% net-profit drop was blamed for a −7% session. Another at Q3 would dent the net-profit headline. It sits below OP and has no path to the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-04-06: '最終減益で着地したことを嫌気' after a special loss; −7.4% on the window.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether a special loss comes this quarter is unknown in advance. It is sized as a small probability-weighted one-off.

outside_window.finding: Yaskawa (6506) reports Mar-Aug results on 2026-10-09. It is the FA bellwether whose July print soured the sector, and it lands after this window.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely; Nachi held the plan at Q3 in 2023, 2024 and 2025, and the plan is already above the IFIS consensus. Returns: none expected; the dividend was already raised to 110 at H1 and buybacks have come separately. New-year guide: n/a (Q3). Quarter: Q3 OP likely 3.8-4.2bn, cumulative about 70% of 15.3bn, against FY2025's Q3 progress of 67.8% of the final actual and 77% of the initial plan. In line to slightly ahead of plan, and well ahead of the stale consensus.
baseline_tension: The findings lean positive against a negative priced lean (−0.886, mostly the margin overhang) and a +5.7% 20-day run-up. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held plan with a clean Q3 beat (no special loss); I looked for a revision or return habit at Q3 and found none, so the upside rests on the quarter alone.
lessons_applied: Positioning finding (crowded margin long and fade) cut from −0.5 to −0.3: it repeats the baseline's margin_overhang lean, so it is partly priced; only the next-day fade inside the window is kept.
